summary.text: Fantasha Allen is the Democratic nominee for the Texas House of Representatives, District 7, and works in social work.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as an East Texas community advocate and graduate-level social work student.

paragraphs.text: Allen earned an associate degree from Tyler Junior College in 2023 and a bachelor's degree from Stephen F. Austin University in 2025, according to Ballotpedia.

She said she holds a Bachelor of Social Work and is pursuing a Master of Social Work through an Advanced Standing Program, and that her work in case management, community outreach and nonprofit engagement has centered on serving families and youth.
Allen's key campaign messages included putting families and communities first, drawing on her social work experience, and accessible, transparent and accountable leadership.
She named affordable healthcare, mental health services, public education, stable housing and workforce opportunities as priorities.
